main_text.p: 45. 1 Thess. 2:14-16. Illinc gentilium, qui præ-judiciis innutriti, vix paterentur euangelium, illos à Deorum patriorum cultu abstrahere laborans; unde gravissimæ persecutiones Euangelii imminebant præco-nibus: quod etiam tot martyriis confirmatum fuit. Adversus hæc mala confirmati sunt præsentiâ Christi, ipsis addictâ, Matth. 28:20. qui non aliter, atque olim fecerat Judæis præsentiæ suæ symbolum dedit conspicuum, mittens spiritum sub signo visibili linguarum quasi ignis, quæ dispartitæ considebant super unoquoque discipulorum. Ille spiritus Christi erat Apostolis itinerum faciendorum index Act. 13:2. 16:6. 7. 9. 10. Ille corroborabat eos magno solatio, atque prospera reddidit eorum itinera. Per illum Christus ubi-que fecit eos videre maxima signa &miracula, ipsis in deserto gentium fidem facientia. Imò præsentem habuerunt Christum potenti suâ defensione, quâ eos liberavit ex variis mortis periculis, &c.[?] hostium insultibus. Act. 16:26. 23:11. 2 Cor. 11:23-27. Act. 27:23. 24.

page.notes: The lower part of the page (between the text and the catchword) shows only faint, blurred marks that look like show-through from the other side; nothing legible is printed there, so it is left out. "&miracula" and "&c. hostium" are uncertain: the ampersand forms are doubtful and are marked [?]. The section number "45." and the reference "1 Thess. 2:14-16." stand at the start of the column and are given as a left-side note. The paragraph begins mid-argument ("Illinc"), so it is marked as a continuation. The strip at the right edge is from the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.
